name: hushwing-audio
title: Hushwing
description: Private, client-side voice isolation for audio and video. Enhances media locally with WebAssembly and Web Audio; nothing is uploaded.
privacy: No network calls are made with your media. Processing happens in the page.
output: The output follows the source: a video comes back as a video with the enhanced track muxed back in, audio as a 48 kHz mono WAV. There is no format option.
flow: One page, no wizard: main[data-mcp-target="studio"] holds the drop target, the engine choice and the job queue at once. Set the file input, pick an engine with [data-mcp-target="model-selector"], press button[data-mcp-action="process-queue"] when the queue has something in it, then poll li[data-job-id]. There is no in-app preview: judge a result by running the queue and downloading it.

engines.webaudio: Pure-JS voice-band chain (high-pass, expander, compressor, limiter) rendered at 16 kHz.
engines.rnnoise: Real RNNoise WebAssembly at its native 48 kHz, rendered through an offline audio graph.

tools.name: getModels
tools.description: List the enhancement models that are actually implemented in this build.

tools.name: processMedia
tools.description: Queue one file, process it, and resolve with the enhanced media blob. The output container follows the source.

tools.name: queueMedia
tools.description: Add a file to the queue without waiting for the result.

tools.name: getJobs
tools.description: Read the current queue: id, status, progress, stage, result URL, any error and any non-fatal warning.

decoder.description: Which reader produced the PCM. WAV is parsed in JS and everything mediabunny can demux is decoded with the browser's own codecs, so those never download the ffmpeg core; only AVI and friends reach ffmpeg.

tools.name: downloadDebugLog
tools.description: Download the rolling diagnostic log as a .txt file.

domHooks.studio: main[data-mcp-target="studio"] — present as soon as the page renders, on every route
domHooks.upload: input[data-mcp-action="upload"] — hidden file input; agents set `.files` or dispatch `change`
domHooks.buildMarker: [data-mcp-target="build-marker"] — the commit and build time the page is running

urlParameters.autostart: true — begins processing as soon as files are added (?autostart=true)
urlParameters.coi: off — disables the cross-origin isolation service worker (?coi=off)

nativeDecoders: mediabunny (mp3, flac, m4a/aac, ogg/vorbis, opus, and audio inside mp4/mov/mkv/webm)
ffmpegDecoders: and any container/codec the browser cannot decode natively
capabilities.videoOutput: The container follows the source's codec: webm stays webm, mp4/mov stay mp4/mov, avi stays avi, and anything else is remuxed to mkv so the picture is never dropped. Video is copied, never re-encoded.
capabilities.queue: One job at a time; files added while a batch drains are picked up automatically.
